correctness.rationale: Integrated Lindblad survivor X=∫rho dt solves -L_u X=P1 because positivity and nearest-neighbor couplings force finite-time strictly decreasing trace and uniform exponential absorption by compactness. Nine real integrated equations give T(u)=3/kappa+[2(G+kappa)-u]/4+Delta^2(G+kappa+u)/[4+u(G+kappa-u)]. Independent Liouvillian 9x9 inversion at five parameter choices matches this formula within 4e-15. Symbolic derivatives yield T"=2Delta^2[((G+kappa-u)^3+2u^3+12u)]/[4+u(G+kappa-u)]^3>0 when Delta!=0. Endpoint derivative signs exhaust and uniquely classify minima, with Delta=0 strictly decreasing. For G+kappa<2 thresholds Delta_S and Delta_T from respective endpoint roots satisfy Delta_S<Delta_T due strict derivative monotonicity, giving source/interior/target regimes. No finite sample is used as proof of convexity.
residual_risks: Single-excitation Lindblad model, no interactions, site-2 dephasing or finite-time quantiles; extension to larger chains not shown.
The all-source optimizer regime requires κ²>=2G²+4, and remaining parameters use exact endpoint derivative tests.
